questions.stem: You are seeing a 65-year-old man with a history of progressive systolic heart failure and hypotension in the cardiac care unit. Echocardiogram shows a severe reduction in left ventricular function and you clinically make the diagnosis of cardiogenic shock. You wish to start a medication that will increase the inotropic state of his heart. Which intracellular ion will increase as a result of this medication and will be responsible for increasing myocardial contractility?
